text_block_list.text:
In front of the TV, Taiki Shuttle watches 
the race featuring Matikanefukukitaru and 
Silence Suzuka, who had just returned from 
Hong Kong.

That race became an "unforgettable" one, 
with Silence Suzuka securing victory by 
more than ten lengths ahead of second 
place.

Seeing her friend claim victory, Taiki 
Shuttle cheered with pure, unadulterated 
joy and kicked off a victory party.
